comment: Ratchet budgets for the whole-pattern-corpus Solidity compile suite. 'condition_todo_occurrences' counts every 'false /* TODO' occurrence (if/while/require contexts). Lower a budget when a change improves the metric; do not raise one without recording why in logs/. RAISED for the flattened shape (the only shape the pipeline produces since 2026-09-23, when the pre-inlining mode switch was removed -- see logs/20260923-04-remove-evm-inline-switch.md): the calldata chains are expanded before type recovery, so the shared bound/revert scaffolding is duplicated per call site and the structurer emits more gotos/TODOs. The raise and the pre-inlining numbers are recorded in logs/20260920-02-evm-entry-poly-worklist-blowup-root-cause.md section 11.11. The helper floors are anchored to the flattened counts; the pre-inlining floors were 1339/1301. LOWERED on 2026-09-22 after the Phoenix reduceSequenceOnce continuation fix (logs/20260922-02-structurer-terminal-arm-join-fix.md): goto 5437->3640, real jumps 4604->3175, dangling 501->55, condition TODO 4647->4303, and the helper_call_sites floor 2412->2408 because structured bodies no longer repeat helper call statements across goto copies. RE-ANCHORED on 2026-09-22 after the entry-continuation fix (logs/20260922-03-entry-continuation-and-block-order-fix.md): the wide continuation rule plus entry-first block order in collapseNodes removes the goto flood for good (goto 3640->1787, real jumps 3175->1695, condition TODO 4303->4078, helper_call_sites 2408->2442), so those budgets are lowered to the new actuals. The two raised budgets are direct consequences of no longer dropping the function entry node: dangling 55->58 because the additionally recovered blocks include guard-revert branches whose '// block_N:' label the renderer folds into require(), and unresolved 289->297 because the previously lost entry-block statements (which carry the bound checks) are rendered again. RE-ANCHORED on 2026-09-23 after the source-cases regression fix (logs/20260923-05-source-cases-follow-absorb-fix.md): a region no longer folds the placeholder node that models its exit, finalize re-points entering edges at the final structured root, a natural-loop region is entered at its head for the dominance analysis, and a guard that skips the following loop nests it instead of emitting a goto. That recovers control flow that used to be dropped or flattened: goto 1787->1192, real jumps 1695->1111, dangling 58->5, unresolved 297->289, helper_call_sites 2442->2421. condition TODO is RAISED 4078->4494: every branch that is now rendered as an if/while needs a condition expression, and the conditions of the newly recovered guards/latches are often still unresolved by type recovery, so a goto or a dropped guard turns into 'false /* TODO'. The increase is spread over exactly the cases whose goto counts fell (per-case table in the log); the condition work belongs to the type-recovery line, not to the structurer. LOWERED on 2026-09-24 after dynamic calldata tail recovery (logs/20260924-02-dynamic-bytes-length.md): EvmCalldataAccessPass annotates the length word of a dynamic argument (the load at head + 4) and the Solidity backend renders it as <arg>.length for bytes/string, so the guards and returns over bytes calldata no longer collapse to TODO: condition TODO 4494->4440, unresolved 289->288. The string-valued case is pinned in notdec.evm.solidity_source (dynamic_bytes_length_01).
